entities.summary: Tallinn City Museum is a city museum in Tallinn, Estonia. The museum was founded in 1937 as Historic Museum of the City of Tallinn. Since 2015 the museum co-operates with Google Inc. In October 2016 co-operation resulted from virtual Tallinn City Museum on Google Arts & Culture platform.
